sequence_description: Direct JWT login: ensure Vault rejects unsigned (alg=none) and attacker-signed JWTs while accepting a valid control token; uses two identities to ensure rejection is not identity-specific.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_alg_none_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_alg_none_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Vault accepted an unsigned JWT (alg=none); authenticity was not enforced on the consumed proof.

sequence_description: Direct JWT login: ensure Vault rejects unsigned (alg=none) and attacker-signed JWTs while accepting a valid control token; uses two identities to ensure rejection is not identity-specific.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_resign_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_resign_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Vault accepted a JWT signed by an untrusted key; signature verification policy was not applied to the consumed proof.

sequence_description: Config-change + re-auth: rotate trust anchor from control key to attacker key and ensure old-key tokens are rejected after rotation; uses two identities and explicit re-login to detect stale acceptance.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_rotate_alice_oldkey_post_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_rotate_alice_oldkey_post_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Vault continued accepting JWTs signed by the old key after trust-anchor rotation; verification policy may not match the consumed proof.

sequence_description: I1 attack: JWKS trust-anchor rotation with potential stale JWKS cache acceptance of an old signing key (Verify uses updated policy, Consume still accepts old proof). Includes control login with new key after rotation.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_oldkey_after_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_oldkey_after_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Vault accepted a JWT signed by the previously trusted JWKS key after JWKS rotation (stale trust anchor / proof-policy mismatch).

sequence_description: I2 expired_token: ensure exp in the past is rejected even when clock_skew_leeway is large; includes control login and a second identity attack login.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_expired_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_expired_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Expired JWT was accepted (possible expiration enforcement bypass via clock skew/leeway interaction)

sequence_description: Rotate JWT trust anchor from key-A to key-B using jwt_validation_pubkeys; old key-A signed JWT must be rejected after rotation.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_rotate_attack_oldkey_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_rotate_attack_oldkey_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: After rotating trusted pubkeys to key-B only, Vault still accepted a JWT signed by old key-A (stale trust anchor / non-atomic update).

sequence_description: Attack: Configure role with empty claim_constraints ({}). Hypothesis: Vault may treat empty constraints as 'no constraints' and grant policies, violating authorization binding if admin intended a constraint gate.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_empty_constraints_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_empty_constraints_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Role with empty claim_constraints unexpectedly allowed login; empty constraints may be treated as unconstrained, enabling over-grant relative to intended authorization gate.

sequence_description: Attack: Login under a role that initially grants broad policy, then admin tightens role to remove that policy. Hypothesis: previously issued token may retain permissions beyond updated BrokerPolicy; verify that old session cannot read after tighten (authorization binding to current broker policy).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_before_tighten_broad_read_after_tighten_http_status == 403
Evaluation: user_before_tighten_broad_read_after_tighten_http_status=200 == 403 → False
Implication: Session issued before role tightening retained access to broad path after policy removal, exceeding current BrokerPolicy(config).

sequence_description: Attack empty_audience: create a role without bound_audiences and attempt to authenticate with arbitrary aud values; ensure Vault does not grant access beyond intended audience binding.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_aud1_login_status >= 400 AND user_attacker_aud2_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: (user_attacker_aud1_login_status=200 >= 400 → False) AND (user_attacker_aud2_login_status=200 >= 400 → False)
Implication: Role missing bound_audiences accepted arbitrary aud values and issued tokens, violating intended audience-based authorization binding

sequence_description: Attack empty_bound_claims: start with a role gated by a claim constraint, then modify role to empty claim_constraints and re-auth as a non-matching identity; ensure Vault does not treat empty constraints as permissive and grant access.
description: [PlatformVerify:vault] [PlatformVerify:vault] Claim constraint bypass: claim 'department' sent='engineering' (type=str) does not match bound='finance' (type=str), but login succeeded. Platform accepted a credential violating its own configured constraint.
